concerns.text: Task T001a (create repository directories) is not linked to any functional requirement (FR) or success criterion (SC) in the spec; it appears solely for project scaffolding and constitutes over‑reach.
Task T001b (create code/tests directories) has no corresponding FR/SC; it is an infrastructure step not required by the specification.
Task T002 (add .flake8 config and run ruff/black linting) is not referenced by any FR or SC; while useful for code quality, the spec does not mandate linting, making this an over‑reach.

Task T004 (populate requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, ruff.toml) is not mapped to any FR/SC; the spec only requires reproducibility via pinned dependencies, which is already satisfied by the existing requirements file.

Task T006 (compute SHA‑256 checksums for raw files) is not directly covered by any FR/SC; data‑hygiene is a constitutional principle but not an explicit functional requirement, so this task is over‑reach.
Task T007 (validate checksums.json against its schema) lacks a corresponding FR/SC; checksum validation is a supporting activity, not a requirement in the spec.
Task T040 (generate checksums for all artifacts) is not tied to any FR/SC; the spec does not require artifact‑level checksum generation beyond raw data hygiene.
Task T041 (create a README documenting artifacts) is not mentioned in the spec; while helpful for users, it is not a required deliverable.
Task T042 (tag repository with a version bump) is not linked to any FR/SC; version tagging is a project‑management convenience, not a functional requirement.
